kind: bug / Graph / Tensor method argument parsing
title: Tensor.expand fails in Graph mode while broadcast_to works on the same shape
duplicate_search_result: No exact matching GitHub or Gitee issue found.
documentation_notes: MindSpore 2.9 local Tensor.expand is defined as def expand(self, *size) and says its size parameter is the same as the broadcast_to shape parameter.
MindSpore 2.9 local Graph standard_method.expand is defined as def expand(input, size), which does not accept varargs and converts the supplied size through TensorToTuple.
Tensor.broadcast_to((2, 3)) compiles and runs in Graph mode on the same input.
classification_notes: Not a numerical precision issue: the result is exact broadcasting of a small row tensor.
Not an unsupported broadcast kernel issue: Tensor.broadcast_to((2, 3)) works in Graph mode on CPU.
The failure is localized to Graph parsing/lowering of Tensor.expand arguments.
